_doc: Low horizontal slash, starts on the arm's LEFT, ends on its RIGHT. end = hand position (m) and pan at the end; start = windup offsets from end; roll 90 = jaw swings sideways; jaw_open = how wide the sword cocks; t_windup, t_slash seconds.

_help.end.x: hand distance forward at the end of the slash (m, keep <= 0.27)
_help.end.z: height of the low line (m above the base plane)
_help.end.pan: where the slash ends (deg; + = own right)
_help.start.dx: windup hand offset from the end, forward (m; negative = pulled back)
_help.start.dz: windup hand offset from the end, up (m)
_help.start.pan: where the slash starts (deg; negative = own left)
_help.jaw_open: how wide the sword cocks before the sweep (0..100): smaller = comes from less wide
_help.t_windup: seconds: rest -> cocked low on the start side
_help.captured.start: windup pose (real degrees), extrapolated from arm B's posed ATTACK_LOW_RL (mirrored for LR); overrides start.*
_help.captured.end: end pose (real degrees), extrapolated from arm B's posed ATTACK_LOW_RL: sweep to the centre with the arm extended so the blade reaches
_help.t_pause: seconds held at the strike-ready pose before the strike (a beat of stillness)
_help.retract: after the strike, back out this fraction of the way toward the strike-ready pose so the blade comes off the other arm before the next transition (0 = none)
